name: NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand Switch
bandwidth_basis: PER LANE, PER DIRECTION. Each XDR 800Gb/s port = 100 GB/s per direction. Switch provides 144 XDR ports.
switching: 144 ports of 800 Gb/s per switch. SHARP v4 in-network reduction, adaptive routing, telemetry-based congestion control, performance isolation, low-power link state, power profiling.
notes: Quantum-X800 is the current flagship InfiniBand switch. Product page states 144 ports of 800 Gb/s connectivity per port, SHARP v4, adaptive routing, telemetry-based congestion control. Part of the Quantum-X800 platform with ConnectX-8 SuperNICs. Silicon photonics versions available for reduced power and latency. The switch doubles per-port bandwidth over Quantum-2 while increasing port count from 64 to 144.
